observation.visible_scene: A shirtless man lies back at the edge of an outdoor pool, his head tilted upward and to the side so that his ear and wet dark hair are visible, while a hand grips at the right edge of the frame. A vertical column of water pours continuously from above onto his face. The background shows a wooden fence and out-of-focus autumn foliage (red and yellow leaves) above the pool surface. The man's body and head remain in essentially the same position throughout, and the camera is static relative to the scene.
visible_changes: The white frothy splash around the impact point on the face grows progressively larger and more diffuse, spreading from a compact burst in the early frames into a broad foam cloud that increasingly envelops the face and obscures the ear and the dark mass of hair.
The dark region over the face (wet hair/face in shadow) becomes less distinct as the foam thickens and covers it.
The number and spread of airborne droplets increase, with more spray scattering to the left and upward in later frames.
The vertical water stream continues to descend onto the head across the whole excerpt, maintaining its column shape while the splash crown at its base expands.
The man's head, shoulder, chest, and the gripping hand at the right stay in fixed positions; the visible change is expansion of the splash around a stationary head, not translation of the body.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the water stream began before this segment or continues after it, and what produces it.
Whether the man's head or body moves outside these crop boundaries.
The exact identity of the dark mass over the face (shadowed wet hair versus facial features).
uncertain_details: Any very slight tilt of the head is hard to confirm against the growing foam.
Minor camera motion is not clearly supported by the background, which appears fixed.
